meta.phase-name: Schema Contract Cleanup and JSON Schema Import Path

phase-summary.outcome: Hard-coded schema presets, fake authored `spaces` fields, and privileged trait/semantic payload names were removed from the touched Space Explorer and engine vector surfaces. The app now has a real importable JSON Schema path and neutral vector metadata naming.

changes.change: Removed hard-coded preset/default schema rows and semantic-axis defaults from the engine vector model surface.
Changed generated/recomputed payload metadata from privileged `traitNames`/`featureNames`/`projections.trait` naming to neutral vector naming.
Made the repo schema document the source of vector dimensions for `space-data.json` generation.
Established `content-packs.schema.json` as the importable JSON Schema contract for the repo-editable content schema document.

requriements-suggestions.item: Future schema work should continue collapsing legacy `contentFeatures`/`powerFeatures` naming into schema-authored stat-set concepts once gameplay/runtime surfaces are ready for that migration.
